challenges.rationale: GWAS claims support for metabolic disease, but A7 (fulfillment) notes no CAD associations and A1/A5 (burden) show LoF increases CAD risk, suggesting conflicting metabolic directions.
Tolerance agent claims high safety (LOEUF 2.3), but Safety agent (A3) identifies strong associations with myeloid leukemias and hematologic malignancies from LoF.
The claim that lifelong inhibition is well-tolerated based on LOEUF/DepMap is directly contradicted by the Safety agent's evidence of hematologic malignancy risk in A3.
